name: commerce
description: Vendor shopping verbs (shop/browse/buy/sell/checkout) and balance display. `buy` with no vendor NPC in the room hands off to the `storefront.buy_by_name` action (player-owned shop displays) before refusing. Vendor services (stock, pricing, trust, restock) stay engine. Also owns shop HOURS as a room rule: a `commerce:shop-hours` move gate locks an interior shop while every vendor who works it is off the clock, and a 30s closing sweep puts anyone still inside back out on the street. And SELF-SERVICE: goods pulled from a `vendor_stock` display cooler carry an unpaid mark (engine stamps it), `checkout` settles it at a `checkout`-flagged counter, and carrying it out of the shop building emits `shoplifting.caught` for surveillance to charge. The door asks first: a `commerce:unpaid-door` move gate stops you once with what you're holding and what it costs, and `yes`/`no` answer it (yes settles, or puts the goods back if you're short, then walks you out; no walks you out and lets the theft charge). The prompt is shared — `commerce.arm_door_prompt` lets another plugin's shop door use the same yes/no with its own settle action. And the shop DOOR (shopdoor.js): a closed shop is now a real `lock:shoplock` door on the facade↔interior link, so unlock/hack/bash/burglary/knock all reach a shopfront through machinery that already exists — 49 of 84 scheduled shops had no door row at all and 32 more had one carrying no lock, which is why `npcAutoLockable` (the shopkeeper locking up on the way home) never fired for any of them. The hours gate ABSTAINS once that lock is beaten, or the hack buys nothing; the lock state is synced on a CHANGE of trading state only, so a forced door stays forced; auth is a resident of the building and nobody else; and the trading-hours card is derived from `vendor_schedule` and reaches `examine door` through the new `door.describe` gather hook.

shop.note: KNOWN GAP: vendor NPC verb; examine shows only talk/attack for NPCs. Discoverable via the click-a-vendor shop panel / dialogue, not examine.

browse.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of shop; same NPC gap.

buy.note: KNOWN GAP: targets on-scene vendor via resolveVendor; NPC-gated, discoverable via shop panel.

sell.note: KNOWN GAP: targets on-scene vendor via resolveVendor; NPC-gated, discoverable via shop panel.

checkout.note: Gated on a furniture counter flagged `checkout: <npcId>` in the room; taught by the unpaid-goods line printed when you pull from a vendor_stock cooler.
